cycle.alt: A cycle diagram: from a prompt, generate builds a plan and empty grounding, run executes the plan while accumulating records and replays without AI on a hit, and only when something breaks does heal update the plan, the grounding, or both after approval.

nodes.label: GENERATE · AI
nodes.text: AI builds a plan from the prompt (usually one call)

nodes.label: PLAN + GROUNDING
nodes.text: Two derived files appear alongside it

nodes.label: RUN · 0 AI CALLS ON HIT
nodes.text: Replays without AI once records hit

nodes.label: HEAL · AI · APPROVE BEFORE WRITE
nodes.text: Fixes it only after approval, only when broken
